cues: The story is set in the nineteen eighties, when Australia had officially adopted multiculturalism: many cultures accepted side by side, rather than migrants being expected to melt into the majority.
Families from southern and eastern Europe had long settled in the cheaper inner suburbs.
Winton's street, with Macedonian, Polish, Italian and Greek neighbours, is what that policy looked like on the ground.
